title: The Slow Hand Primer
summary: A first primer that teaches the student to slow the passing of time inside a limb and to quicken it in the hand and to feel the pace of a blow.

title: A Handbook of Counted Breath
summary: A handbook of short drills in which the student counts breaths and heartbeats until the count itself steadies the sense of time in a fight.

title: The Quickening Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of small acts of haste that run the time in a hand or a foot ahead of the body and hasten the mending of small hurts.

title: A Primer of Passing Moments
summary: A primer on feeling how moments pass and leave traces so that a student can read where a person has been and stretch a moment against them.
